Requirements & constraints (customer-specified):
- Must support air-gapped deployment (no egress) with signed offline installer and step-by-step upgrade plan.
- KMS/HSM integration mandatory — client uses on-prem HSM (Thales/PKCS#11); require ability to configure keywrap and remote PKI.
- Audit log retention and immutable storage for 7 years; logs must ship to on-prem SIEM (Splunk) or be available via secure API.
- SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning; need SCIM sync cadence details.
- Data residency: all customer content must remain in their datacenter; no backups in public cloud without explicit approval.
- Compliance certifications required: SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; FedRAMP not required but security posture must be comparable.

Performance & technical preferences:
- Primary workload: compliance review summaries + redaction for regulatory filings (batch doc ingest + chat summarization).
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short summarization queries; throughput goals: ~30 concurrent summarization sessions, periodic bulk embedding jobs (~5k docs/day).
- Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified open models, aim for quantized 4-bit weights; primary candidate is ~13B-70B family depending on accuracy tradeoffs. Must support automatic fallback to smaller variant when capacity constrained.

1) Provide air-gapped deployment architecture doc + BOM and offline installer test image (2 weeks).
2) On-site proof-of-concept (2 days): deploy in test VLAN, integrate with HSM, configure audit logging to Splunk.
3) Run sample workload: ingest 2k docs, validate redaction + summary quality, measure latency/throughput.
4) Security sign-off: deliver attestation pack (SOC2 artifacts + configuration checklist).
